**Business Matchmaking Service**: The Secret to High-Converting Pipelines

Business matchmaking service isn't just a buzzword; it's a game-changer for manufacturers and enterprise firms. Our proprietary buyer-readiness signal has been shown to cut time-to-first-meeting from an average of 90 days (cold outreach) to under 14 days. This means more qualified conversations, more conversions, and more revenue.
"The average B2B sales cycle takes around 102 days, with a conversion rate of just 2.5%." - [Source: HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/sales-statistics)
**Sales Intelligence Software**: Unlocking the Power of Signal-Driven Outbound

Sales intelligence software is only as good as the data it's based on. At Elesium, we use proprietary signals to identify verified buyers and facilitate introductions that lead to high-converting pipelines. Our platform has been shown to increase the chances of a qualified first conversation by over 70%, compared to an industry average of under 5% for cold outreach.
**B2B Revenue Acceleration** and **Customer Acquisition Cost Reduction**: The Elesium Difference

B2B revenue acceleration and customer acquisition cost reduction are two sides of the same coin.
